title: World Famous Lover
desc: An anthology of four inspiring love stories that showcase the diverse perspectives towards love that are prevalent among the different strata of human society.

title: Kaatru Veliyidai
desc: Air Force pilot Varun remembers his love affair with a doctor while being held prisoner in Pakistan during the Kargil War.

title: Sulthan
desc: Sulthan, a motherless child, is raised by a group of criminals working for his father. However, when his father dies, he decides to reform the group into better people.

title: Madras
desc: A wall creates discord between two factions of a political party. Kaali and his friend Anbu, who is a political aspirant, get embroiled in the brutal political rivalry.

title: Action
desc: Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit.

title: Vacha Kuri Thappaathu
desc: Karthik, a businessman, gets married to a rich woman, to increase his wealth. However, things change, when he falls in love with an environmental activist, who files a suit against his company.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.

title: Mikhael
desc: When rival gang members are killed mysteriously, the police begin an investigation. Later, their probe leads them to a physician who is seeking retribution.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Raame Aandalum Raavane Aandalum
desc: An impoverished rural couple look for their prized bulls, which have gone missing. However, they receive little help from a community that is apathetic to their plight.

title: Sathiya Sothanai
desc: Pradeep's life turns upside down when he is accused of a murder after discovering the dead body of an influential villager along with some precious jewels.

title: DeAr
desc: Marital bliss is disrupted for a newlywed pair when the husband, a sensitive sleeper, discovers his wife's snoring problem.

title: Kadaisi Ulaga Por
desc: In the year 2028, a power struggle on an international level creates political turmoil in India. Thamizh, a common man, rises to the occasion to save the day.

title: Ungalukkaga Oruvan
desc: K Rishi Kumar becomes the CEO of a company. However, his life changes when he starts working for the upliftment of farmers.

title: Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a teacher, tries to change the ongoing malpractices in a government school. Unfortunately, his acts are not welcomed by a few senior members and students, which leads to a rift between them.

title: Shivan
desc: A man and a woman are in love with each other but on the day of their wedding, he ends up killing her. Soon, in prison, he realises the conspiracy behind the crime and plans to solve the mystery.
